summary: ADP V0.2 P06: wire the six-theme visual/motion gate into GitHub CI so dropping the Owner's UI/motion design fails the push instead of relying on memory. New workflow arxiv-daily-push-visual-gate.yml runs visual_regression_ci.py on worker/baseline/tool changes and exits non-zero on BLOCK. Also discovered that arxiv-daily-push-stage1-bootstrap's runtime-change-scope regex excludes deploy/cloudflare/worker_cloud.js, so its green 'success' on recent worker pushes was the classifier job succeeding while the real check was SKIPPED -- ADP CI had never checked the worker. An auditable approvals path is provided so an approved visual change does not require deleting the workflow. Registers the workflow in governance/workflow_policy.json (the CI audit had failed with 'unowned workflows') and adds a governance test that reads the WORKING TREE, closing the blind spot that made the local pre-commit audit vacuous for the very file being added.
